text: With no controls, it pre-answers the likely filters (cheapest, nonstop, under $550) in prose and asks for the rest, turning one interaction into a conversation.
a2ui: Has the right controls and a Select button on every flight that sends its bound flight number, but the list cannot react to the filters without an agent round trip.
html: Filters apply instantly, the cheapest match is tagged, an empty state offers a reset and a tray tracks the pick; the pick then has nowhere to go from inside the sandbox.
agui: Returns the cleanest result (typed filters plus one flight number), but rules cannot filter the table or the radio options, so the filter controls do nothing visible.
